body.message:
Hello Prithvi,

We would like to kindly inform you that if you wish to extend your stay at Urban Oasis, we will be more than happy to assist you.

Please note that the rate for the extension will be slightly different, however we have offered you a special consideration for the inconvenience caused due to the last-minute changes.

For your extension in June and July, we can offer a special rate of AED 5,500 per month.

We truly appreciate your understanding and look forward to assisting you further.
